==Descriptions==
Around 2021, at least eight [[maps]] were created for an at the time upcoming 2021 PVP mode, which was eventually scrapped, making all the maps unused. These maps are '''Battlefront''', '''Castle Outskirts''', '''Dusty Ruins''', '''Waste Ground''', '''Fraction Zone''', '''WIP City''', '''Backwoods''' and a castle map whose name is not known, which will be referred to as '''Unknown Castle Map''' on the wiki. Some of these maps had two versions, though the second version generally only had additional details not present on the first one.

[[PVP]] has an entirely new set of maps made for it, so it is unlikely these maps will ever be added to the game. Some of them, such as [[Crash Course]], do resemble maps made for the 2021 version of PVP, in this case that being '''WIP City''', though they are not the same map.

==Design & Path==
{{Tabber
|Backwoods
|'''Backwoods''' consists of two small towns surrounded by hills on all sides. These two locations are separated by a gap in the ground. In these towns, there are a few small houses with roofs colored after the team, a store with a parking lot in front of it and a small park with a fountain. The towns have multiple grey roads, some blocked by blockades.

The path starts and ends at a tunnel. It takes multiple turns around the building, avoiding all the blockades set on the path.
<gallery>
BackwoodsView.png|View of the map.
BattlefrontMapView2.png|View of the map.
BackwoodsIconV1.png|Icon of the map.
</gallery>
|Battlefront
|'''Battlefront''', as the name suggests, takes place at a battlefront. It is located in a grass area surrounded by trees. There are two trenches in the terrain, one for the red team and the other for the blue team. These trenches contain multiple crates and walls. On each side, there is a flagpole with a flag colored after the team color.

The path starts and ends at an underground tunnel. The path takes multiple turns, making each straight path rather short.
<gallery>
BattlefrontView.png|View of the map.
BattlefrontIconV1.png|Icon of the map.
</gallery>
|Castle Outskirts
|'''Castle Outskirts''' is located in a flat area surrounded by multiple hills. The map contains two sides separated by a row of rocks. Each side has multiple medieval buildings with roofs colored based on which team's side they are on. There are also a few small cliffs and trees scattered around the location.

The black path starts and ends at a cave. It takes multiple turns, avoiding all natural and man-made structures on the path.

This map had two versions shown. The second version had its path replaced with a brown dirt path and multiple objects on the map have been relocated.
<gallery>
CastleOutskirtsView2021.png|View for the first version of the map.
CastleOutskirts2021 View2.png|View for the first version of the map.
CastleOutskirtsIconV1.png|Icon for the first version of the map.
</gallery>
|Dusty Ruins
|'''Dusty Ruins''' is a barren location located in the desert. It is surrounded by multiple hills. The map is split into two parts by a row of rocks. On each side, there are a few wooden crates, colorful barrels based on which team's side they are on and a single flag colored after the team. Multiple sand cliffs can also be found on the map.

The sand path starts and ends at a cave. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding the multiple cliffs present on the map.

The second version of the map had a slightly more detailed path.

Gameplay of the second version of this map was featured in [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}_EPelwsaF9E Roblox 2021 Cinematic] video uploaded to Youtube by Roblox. It also shows a few enemies from 2021 PVP which never made it into the game, these being the Enraged Boss and Enraged Giant.
<gallery>
DustyRuinsView.png|View for the first version of the map.
DustyRuinsViewV2.png|View for the second version of the map.
DustyRuinsIconV1.png|Icon for the first version of the map.
</gallery>
|Fraction Zone
|'''Fraction Zone''' is a settlement located in snowy hills. It is an area surrounded by hills on all sides. The playable area is split into two halves by a few ice hills. Multiple tents colored based on which team's side they are located in are present on the map. A few wooden crates can also be found scattered around the map.

The path starts and ends at a cave. It takes multiple turns, avoiding the multiple ice cliffs present on the map.

The second version of the map had slightly different tents, as it contained green ones. However, this could just be team colors being removed from the map image, similarly to how the team flags in the '''Battlefront''' second icon are white.
<gallery>
FractionZoneView.png|View for the map.
FractionZoneView2.png|View for the map.
FractionZoneIconV1.png|Icon for the map.
</gallery>
|Unknown Castle Map
|'''Unknown Castle Map''' is located inside a castle. Due to there only being a blurry icon of the map, not many details are known on its appearance. The map itself is surrounded by multiple castle walls. It also has a few small cliffs and rocks. It had a grey path with yellow outlines.
|Waste Ground
|'''Waste Ground''' is, as the name suggests, a map located in a waste ground. The ground is entirely grey and all the trees on the map are dead. The map is surrounded by hills on two sides and by sand on the other two sides. The map is split into two halves by a small gap between the two halves. Each half has a few lamp posts, utility poles and metal fences. A few cliffs can also be seen.

The path starts and ends at a cave. It takes multiple turns, avoiding various structures on the map.
<gallery>
WasteGroundView.png|View for the map.
WasteGroundView2.png|View for the map.
WasteGroundIconV1.png|Icon for the map.
WasteGroundIcon2.png|Icon for the map.
</gallery>
|WIP City
|'''WIP City''' takes place in a large city. The city contains multiple buildings, most of which have placeholder textures. The buildings on the edges of the city are colored orange while the ones in the playable area are colored after the team color. A few lamps, crates and dumpsters can be seen around the map. The city also has a few grassy areas with trees and a parking lot, though no cars can be seen in them.

The path starts and ends at a tunnel. The path takes multiple turns to avoid the buildings present on this map.
<gallery>
WIPCityView.png|View for the map.
WIPCityIconV1.png|Icon for the map.
</gallery>
}}

==Trivia==
*'''WIP City''' strongly resembles the unfinished developer texture style seen in incomplete projects, hence its name.
*'''Castle Outskirts''' is an updated version of [[Castle Outskirts]], a [[Versus]] map from 2019.
*One of the enemies that was meant to be used in 2021 PVP can actually be accessed in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, that is the legacy [[Enraged]].
**[[Enraged]] was part of a group of similarly named and looking enemies intended for the mode. The other enraged enemies include the Enraged Boss and Enraged Giant.<gallery>
LegacyEnragedIconIG.png|[[Enraged]]
LegacyEnragedBossIconIG.png|Enraged Boss
LegacyEnragedGiantIconIG.png|Enraged Giant
</gallery>
***All the enraged enemies not present in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode can be seen in [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_EPelwsaF9E Roblox 2021 Cinematic] video.
**The boss of the mode, Abyss, can also be seen in the lobby's event area for the [[Null & Void Event]] and in [[Banlands]], it was also included in the [[Roblox Multipack - Cyber City]] containing the Abyss enemy, referred to as the Corruption by the toy.<gallery>
AbyssIconIG.png|Abyss
</gallery>
**While far more enemies were made for the mode, none of them were officially teased by the developers or leaked by Roblox.
